title: An exercise: exercises/<id>/exercise.md, after lowering. Findings are its Look for list.

id.description: The exercise id, named by a run entry.

name.description: What the run of show calls it.

core.description: Pins of the Look for rows that stay on the checklist below coreBelow.

coreBelow.description: Below this many minutes only the core rows stay on the checklist. The rest fold as out of scope, and a row left blank counts neither way.

floor.description: Below this many minutes the start page and the activity page warn that it gives little evidence.

paste.description: Text to paste to the candidate.

fallback.description: What to do when the live setup is down. Its switch is shared by everyone in the interview.

lookFor.description: Findings under "### <level>" headings, with the same grammar as a card.

stretch.description: Prompts under "### <level>" headings, as on a card.
